options.content:
Sail systems

Sail-hydraulic PLC data from the sail-systems MQTT adapter. First the **loads and positions** per group (Head, Main, Mizzen, Winches) and the **Mast**, then the **status per function** and the **alarms** in the range, then the **details per function**, grouped the same way. Times are UTC. Loads in t, positions in %. The info icon of each panel says how to read it.

spec.title: Drive speed
spec.description: Solid: actual, dashed: demand. Average per interval. Speed in % or rpm as the drive reports it.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("s_drive/i_actual_speed") AS "s_drive/i_actual_speed",
  avg("s_drive/i_speed_demand") AS "s_drive/i_speed_demand"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/i_actual_speed", "s_drive/i_speed_demand" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/i_actual_speed", "s_drive/i_speed_demand" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/i_actual_speed", "s_drive/i_speed_demand" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/r_actual_torque", "s_drive/r_torque_demand" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n0, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x0, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n1, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x7 FROM sail_systems__fe301_blade_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Load
spec.description: Load in t. Line: average per interval, band: min to max. Dashed red: the PLC's max load.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "blade-sheet-sb-load · st_load/i_load",
  min("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "blade-sheet-sb-load · st_load/i_load min",
  max("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "blade-sheet-sb-load · st_load/i_load max",
  max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_max_load_setting"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_low_torque", c3 AS "ox_pull", c4 AS "s_drive/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c9 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c10 AS "s_drive/x_run", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ox_low_torque") AS c2,
    bool_or("ox_pull") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c3 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c5 AS "st_load/x_failure", c6 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "x_speed_deviation_alarm", c8 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c9 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_speed_deviation_alarm") AS c7,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c8,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c9
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Winches · loads
spec.description: Load in t of each load the loads app shows. Average per interval. Legend: last value and max in the range; click a name to show only that line.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "Primary winch PS (FE212)"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM sail_systems__fe212_primary_deck_winch_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM sail_systems__fe212_primary_deck_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_max_speed_stp', 'i_max_torque_stp', 'st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a', 'st_load/i_load_change_perm_a', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_max_speed_stp", "i_max_torque_stp", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_max_speed_stp", "i_max_torque_stp", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe302_blade_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_pull/ease", c3 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_oo_c", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c12 AS "ix_snsr_in", c13 AS "ix_snsr_line", c14 AS "ix_snsr_out", c15 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c16 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c17 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c18 AS "x_function_enabled", c19 AS "x_group_enabled", c20 AS "x_inner_limit", c21 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c16,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c21
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe203_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe203_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe203_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR next_time IS NULL

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe203_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe203_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n0, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x0, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n1, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x7 FROM sail_systems__fe203_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Load

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_low_torque", c3 AS "ox_pull", c4 AS "s_drive/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c9 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c10 AS "s_drive/x_run", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ox_low_torque") AS c2,
    bool_or("ox_pull") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c3 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c5 AS "st_load/x_failure", c6 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "x_speed_deviation_alarm", c8 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c9 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_speed_deviation_alarm") AS c7,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c8,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c9
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe204_staysail_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE))) AS max

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_pull/ease", c3 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_oo_c", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c12 AS "ix_snsr_in", c13 AS "ix_snsr_line", c14 AS "ix_snsr_out", c15 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c16 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c17 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c18 AS "x_function_enabled", c19 AS "x_group_enabled", c20 AS "x_inner_limit", c21 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c16,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c21
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Line length
spec.description: Line or chain length in cm.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("i_actual_line_length") AS "i_actual_line_length"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Drive speed
spec.description: Solid: actual, dashed: demand. Average per interval. Speed in % or rpm as the drive reports it.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("s_drive/i_actual_speed") AS "s_drive/i_actual_speed",
  avg("s_drive/i_speed_demand") AS "s_drive/i_speed_demand"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/i_actual_speed", "s_drive/i_speed_demand" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/i_actual_speed", "s_drive/i_speed_demand" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "s_drive/i_actual_speed", "s_drive/i_speed_demand" FROM sail_systems__fe303_staysail_sheet_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_low_torque", c3 AS "ox_pull", c4 AS "s_drive/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c9 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c10 AS "s_drive/x_run", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ox_low_torque") AS c2,
    bool_or("ox_pull") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_max_speed_stp', 'i_max_torque_stp', 'st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a', 'st_load/i_load_change_perm_a', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_max_speed_stp", "i_max_torque_stp", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_max_speed_stp", "i_max_torque_stp", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_max_speed_stp") AS n0, max("i_max_speed_stp") AS x0, min("i_max_torque_stp") AS n1, max("i_max_torque_stp") AS x1, min("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS n2, max("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS x2, min("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS n3, max("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS x3, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n4, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x4 FROM sail_systems__fe304_staysail_sheet_sb_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c9 AS "x_function_enabled", c10 AS "x_group_enabled", c11 AS "x_sensr_in", c12 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0201_main_outhaul WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0201_main_outhaul WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0201_main_outhaul WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR next_time IS NULL

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_load/x_failure", c3 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c4 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c5 AS "st_position/x_failure", c6 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c2,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c3,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_missing") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_position/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_position/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_position/x_min_limit_reached") AS c7,
    CASE max("st_position/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_position/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c8
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0201_main_outhaul WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0201_main_outhaul WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0201_main_outhaul WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_feed_forward_pressure_setting', 'st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a', 'st_load/i_load_change_perm_a', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting', 'st_position/i_cylinder_length', 'st_position/i_max_position', 'st_position/i_min_position')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE))) AS max

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_local_pull/ease", c3 AS "x_rc_pull/ease", c4 AS "x_in/out", c5 AS "ox_c_vang_park", c6 AS "ox_d_vang_float", c7 AS "x_cyl_a", c8 AS "x_cyl_b", c9 AS "x_ext_on_off", c10 AS "x_on_off", c11 AS "x_running", c12 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", c13 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c14 AS "x_enable_float", c15 AS "x_function_enabled", c16 AS "x_group_enabled", c17 AS "x_sensr_in", c18 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_local_pull") AND bool_or("x_local_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_local_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("x_local_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("x_local_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_rc_pull") AND bool_or("x_rc_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("x_rc_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_c_vang_park") AS c5,
    bool_or("ox_d_vang_float") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c11,
    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_can_alive") AS c12,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_enable_float") AS c14,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c15,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c16,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c18
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0202_main_vang WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0202_main_vang WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0202_main_vang WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load_bottom/x_failure", "st_load_bottom/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_rod/x_failure", "st_load_rod/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load_bottom/x_failure", "st_load_bottom/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_rod/x_failure", "st_load_rod/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0202_main_vang WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_bottom/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_bottom/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_bottom/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_rod/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_rod/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_rod/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", c9 AS "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", c10 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled", c13 AS "x_sensr_in", c14 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_load_ps/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_load_sb/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c14
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

    CASE max("st_position/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_position/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c16

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0203_main_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,

spec.title: Load
spec.description: Load in t. Line: average per interval, band: min to max. Dashed red: the PLC's max load.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_load",
  min("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_load min",
  max("st_load/i_load") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_load max",
  avg("st_load_lc/i_load") / 100.0 AS "main-preventer-load · st_load_lc/i_load",
  min("st_load_lc/i_load") / 100.0 AS "main-preventer-load · st_load_lc/i_load min",
  max("st_load_lc/i_load") / 100.0 AS "main-preventer-load · st_load_lc/i_load max",
  max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") / 100.0 AS "st_load/i_max_load_setting",
  max("st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting") / 100.0 AS "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load_lc/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load_lc/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "st_cylinder/x_in/out", c3 AS "x_in/out", c4 AS "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", c5 AS "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", c6 AS "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "st_cylinder/x_on_off", c8 AS "st_cylinder/x_running", c9 AS "x_cvlve", c10 AS "x_cyl_a", c11 AS "x_cyl_b", c12 AS "x_ext_on_off", c13 AS "x_on_off", c14 AS "x_running", c15 AS "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", c16 AS "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", c17 AS "st_cylinder/x_local_control", c18 AS "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", c19 AS "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", c20 AS "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", c21 AS "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", c22 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", c23 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c24 AS "x_function_enabled", c25 AS "x_group_enabled", c26 AS "x_sensr_in", c27 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (

    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_cyl_b") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_on_off") AS c7,

    bool_or("x_cvlve") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c14,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_function_enabled") AS c15,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/x_group_enabled") AS c16,

    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_can_alive") AS c22,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c23,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c24,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c25,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c26,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c27
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_in", "st_cylinder/x_out", "x_in", "x_out", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_a", "st_cylinder/x_cyl_b", "st_cylinder/x_ext_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_on_off", "st_cylinder/x_running", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_cylinder/x_function_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_group_enabled", "st_cylinder/x_local_control", "st_cylinder/x_maintenance", "st_cylinder/x_rc_control", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_in", "st_cylinder/x_sensr_out", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0204_main_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR (c22 IS DISTINCT FROM p22) OR (c23 IS DISTINCT FROM p23) OR (c24 IS DISTINCT FROM p24) OR (c25 IS DISTINCT FROM p25) OR (c26 IS DISTINCT FROM p26) OR (c27 IS DISTINCT FROM p27) OR next_time IS NULL

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", c3 AS "st_load/x_failure", c4 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c5 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", c6 AS "st_load_lc/x_failure", c7 AS "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c9 AS "st_position/x_failure", c10 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c11 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c12 AS "st_load_lc/w_can_state", c13 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (

    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c2,
