    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_failure") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_missing") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_position/x_failure") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position/x_max_limit_reached") AS c10,
    bool_or("st_position/x_min_limit_reached") AS c11,
    CASE max("st_load_lc/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_load_lc/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c12,
    CASE max("st_position/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_position/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c13

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cvlve", c4 AS "x_cyl_a", c5 AS "x_cyl_b", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_running", c9 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c10 AS "x_function_enabled", c11 AS "x_group_enabled", c12 AS "x_sensr_in", c13 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cvlve") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c13
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0205_main_cunningham WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0205_main_cunningham WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cvlve", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0205_main_cunningham WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_load/x_failure", c3 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c4 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c5 AS "st_position/x_failure", c6 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c2,

    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0205_main_cunningham WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0205_main_cunningham WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0205_main_cunningham WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR next_time IS NULL

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_pull/ease", c3 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_oo_c", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c12 AS "ix_snsr_in", c13 AS "ix_snsr_line", c14 AS "ix_snsr_out", c15 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c16 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c17 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c18 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled", c21 AS "x_inner_limit", c22 AS "x_outer_limit", c23 AS "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c16,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_overide_vang_pos_block") AS c23
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit", "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit", "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit", "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit", "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit", "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR (c22 IS DISTINCT FROM p22) OR (c23 IS DISTINCT FROM p23) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "s_drive/error_communication", c3 AS "s_drive/error_control", c4 AS "s_drive/error_encoder", c5 AS "s_drive/error_fc_temp", c6 AS "s_drive/error_hv_input", c7 AS "s_drive/error_igbt", c8 AS "s_drive/error_motor_temp", c9 AS "s_drive/error_others", c10 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c11 AS "s_drive/warning_communication", c12 AS "s_drive/warning_control", c13 AS "s_drive/warning_encoder", c14 AS "s_drive/warning_fc_temp", c15 AS "s_drive/warning_hv_input", c16 AS "s_drive/warning_igbt", c17 AS "s_drive/warning_motor_temp", c18 AS "s_drive/warning_others", c19 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c20 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c21 AS "s_drive/x_warning", c22 AS "st_load/x_can_missing", c23 AS "st_load/x_failure", c24 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c25 AS "x_pos_out_of_range", c26 AS "x_power_failure", c27 AS "x_snsr_dti_alarm", c28 AS "x_snsr_line_alarm", c29 AS "x_vang_pos_block_alarm", c30 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c31 AS "st_load/w_can_state", c32 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, c24, c25, c26, c27, c28, c29, c30, c31, c32, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LAG(c24) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p24, LAG(c25) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p25, LAG(c26) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p26, LAG(c27) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p27, LAG(c28) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p28, LAG(c29) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p29, LAG(c30) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p30, LAG(c31) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p31, LAG(c32) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p32, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_communication") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_control") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_encoder") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_fc_temp") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_hv_input") AS c6,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_igbt") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_motor_temp") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/error_others") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_communication") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_control") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_encoder") AS c13,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_fc_temp") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_hv_input") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_igbt") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_motor_temp") AS c17,
    bool_or("s_drive/warning_others") AS c18,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c19,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c20,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_warning") AS c21,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_missing") AS c22,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c23,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c24,
    bool_or("x_pos_out_of_range") AS c25,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c26,
    bool_or("x_snsr_dti_alarm") AS c27,
    bool_or("x_snsr_line_alarm") AS c28,
    bool_or("x_vang_pos_block_alarm") AS c29,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c30,
    CASE max("st_load/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_load/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c31,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c32

spec.title: Line length
spec.description: Line or chain length in cm.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("i_actual_line_length") AS "i_actual_line_length"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Drive speed

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

SELECT unnest(make_array('i_min_vang_position', 'i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_min_vang_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_min_vang_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n9 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x9 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_min_vang_position", "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_min_vang_position", "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_min_vang_position") AS n0, max("i_min_vang_position") AS x0, min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n1, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x7, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n8, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x8, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n9, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x9 FROM sail_systems__fe205_main_sheet_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

    bool_or("x_running_cw") AS c25
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_pull", "x_ease", "s_drive_a/x_running", "s_drive_b/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive_a/x_brake", "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", "s_drive_a/x_ready", "s_drive_a/x_run", "s_drive_b/x_brake", "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", "s_drive_b/x_ready", "s_drive_b/x_run", "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", "s_supply_a/x_power_on", "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", "s_supply_b/x_power_on", "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", "s_supply_c/x_power_on", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_running_ccw", "x_running_cw" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_pull", "x_ease", "s_drive_a/x_running", "s_drive_b/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive_a/x_brake", "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", "s_drive_a/x_ready", "s_drive_a/x_run", "s_drive_b/x_brake", "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", "s_drive_b/x_ready", "s_drive_b/x_run", "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", "s_supply_a/x_power_on", "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", "s_supply_b/x_power_on", "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", "s_supply_c/x_power_on", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_running_ccw", "x_running_cw" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

spec.title: Drive torque
spec.description: Solid: actual, dashed: demand. Average per interval. Torque in Nm.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("s_drive_a/r_actual_torque") AS "s_drive_a/r_actual_torque",
  avg("s_drive_a/r_torque_demand") AS "s_drive_a/r_torque_demand",
  avg("s_drive_b/r_actual_torque") AS "s_drive_b/r_actual_torque",
  avg("s_drive_b/r_torque_demand") AS "s_drive_b/r_torque_demand"

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('r_ease_torque_setting', 'r_pull_torque_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."r_ease_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."r_pull_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."r_ease_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."r_pull_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "r_ease_torque_setting", "r_pull_torque_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "r_ease_torque_setting", "r_pull_torque_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("r_ease_torque_setting") AS n0, max("r_ease_torque_setting") AS x0, min("r_pull_torque_setting") AS n1, max("r_pull_torque_setting") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fe206_main_sheet_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled", c21 AS "x_inner_limit", c22 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c22
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe207_main_halyard_captive_winch WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe207_main_halyard_captive_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe207_main_halyard_captive_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR (c22 IS DISTINCT FROM p22) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n9 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n10 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x9 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x10 AS DOUBLE))) AS max

spec.title: Commands and status

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled", c21 AS "x_inner_limit", c22 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c22
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe405_main_sheet_traveller_winch WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe405_main_sheet_traveller_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe405_main_sheet_traveller_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe405_main_sheet_traveller_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe405_main_sheet_traveller_winch WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n0, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x0, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n1, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x7 FROM sail_systems__fe405_main_sheet_traveller_winch WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c19 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c20 AS "x_function_enabled", c21 AS "x_group_enabled", c22 AS "x_inner_limit", c23 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,

spec.title: Line length

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("i_actual_line_length") AS "i_actual_line_length"
FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe401_main_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_actual_line_length" FROM sail_systems__fe401_main_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Drive speed

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,

spec.title: Commands and status

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c19 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c20 AS "x_function_enabled", c21 AS "x_group_enabled", c22 AS "x_inner_limit", c23 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c23
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR (c22 IS DISTINCT FROM p22) OR (c23 IS DISTINCT FROM p23) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n0, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x0, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n1, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x7, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n8, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x8 FROM sail_systems__fe501_main_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_low_torque", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_running", c9 AS "ix_relay_status", c10 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c11 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c12 AS "s_drive/x_run", c13 AS "x_function_enabled", c14 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("ox_low_torque") AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c8,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c14
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe211_main_runner_retriever_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe211_main_runner_retriever_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe211_main_runner_retriever_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c2 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c3 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c4 AS "x_power_failure", c5 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c6 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c2,

  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0402_mizzen_headsail_tack_adjuster WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c9 AS "x_function_enabled", c10 AS "x_group_enabled", c11 AS "x_sensr_in", c12 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0501_mizzen_outhaul WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0501_mizzen_outhaul WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0501_mizzen_outhaul WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_load/x_failure", c3 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c4 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c5 AS "st_position/x_failure", c6 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c2,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c3,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_missing") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_position/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_position/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,
    bool_or("st_position/x_min_limit_reached") AS c7,
    CASE max("st_position/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_position/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c8
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0501_mizzen_outhaul WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0501_mizzen_outhaul WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0501_mizzen_outhaul WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Commands and status

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_local_pull/ease", c3 AS "x_rc_pull/ease", c4 AS "x_in/out", c5 AS "ox_c_vang_park", c6 AS "ox_d_vang_float", c7 AS "x_cyl_a", c8 AS "x_cyl_b", c9 AS "x_ext_on_off", c10 AS "x_on_off", c11 AS "x_running", c12 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", c13 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c14 AS "x_enable_float", c15 AS "x_function_enabled", c16 AS "x_group_enabled", c17 AS "x_sensr_in", c18 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_local_pull") AND bool_or("x_local_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_local_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("x_local_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("x_local_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_rc_pull") AND bool_or("x_rc_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("x_rc_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_c_vang_park") AS c5,
    bool_or("ox_d_vang_float") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c11,

    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_enable_float") AS c14,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c15,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c16,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c18
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0502_mizzen_vang WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0502_mizzen_vang WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_local_pull", "x_local_ease", "x_rc_pull", "x_rc_ease", "x_in", "x_out", "ox_c_vang_park", "ox_d_vang_float", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_lc/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_enable_float", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0502_mizzen_vang WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR next_time IS NULL
