spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", c9 AS "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", c10 AS "st_position/x_can_alive", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled", c13 AS "x_sensr_in", c14 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_load_ps/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_load_sb/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_alive") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c14
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_load_ps/x_can_alive", "st_load_sb/x_can_alive", "st_position/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_load/x_failure", c3 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c4 AS "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", c5 AS "st_load_ps/x_failure", c6 AS "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", c8 AS "st_load_sb/x_failure", c9 AS "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", c10 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c11 AS "st_position/x_failure", c12 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c13 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c14 AS "st_load_ps/w_can_state", c15 AS "st_load_sb/w_can_state", c16 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c2,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c3,
    bool_or("st_load_ps/x_can_missing") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_load_ps/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,

    bool_or("st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached") AS c9,
    bool_or("st_position/x_can_missing") AS c10,

    CASE max("st_load_sb/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_load_sb/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c15,
    CASE max("st_position/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("st_position/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c16
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/x_can_missing", "st_load_ps/x_failure", "st_load_ps/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_sb/x_can_missing", "st_load_sb/x_failure", "st_load_sb/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_ps/w_can_state", "st_load_sb/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_feed_forward_pressure_setting', 'st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a', 'st_load/i_load_change_perm_a', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting', 'st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting', 'st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting', 'st_position/i_cylinder_length', 'st_position/i_max_position', 'st_position/i_min_position')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n0, max("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x0, min("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS n1, max("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS x1, min("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS n2, max("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS x2, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n3, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x3, min("st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting") AS n4, max("st_load_ps/i_max_load_setting") AS x4, min("st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting") AS n5, max("st_load_sb/i_max_load_setting") AS x5, min("st_position/i_cylinder_length") AS n6, max("st_position/i_cylinder_length") AS x6, min("st_position/i_max_position") AS n7, max("st_position/i_max_position") AS x7, min("st_position/i_min_position") AS n8, max("st_position/i_min_position") AS x8 FROM sail_systems__f0503_mizzen_checkstay_deflector WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "st_load/i_load", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0504_mizzen_cunningham WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", c3 AS "st_load/x_failure", c4 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c5 AS "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", c6 AS "st_load_lc/x_failure", c7 AS "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", c8 AS "st_position/x_can_missing", c9 AS "st_position/x_failure", c10 AS "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", c11 AS "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", c12 AS "st_load_lc/w_can_state", c13 AS "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0506_mizzen_boom_preventer WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "st_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/x_can_missing", "st_load_lc/x_failure", "st_load_lc/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_can_missing", "st_position/x_failure", "st_position/x_max_limit_reached", "st_position/x_min_limit_reached", "st_load_lc/w_can_state", "st_position/w_can_state" FROM sail_systems__f0506_mizzen_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR next_time IS NULL

spec.title: Configuration

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n8 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x8 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0506_mizzen_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_load_lc/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0506_mizzen_boom_preventer WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_pull/ease", c3 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_oo_c", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c12 AS "ix_snsr_in", c13 AS "ix_snsr_line", c14 AS "ix_snsr_out", c15 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c16 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c17 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c18 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled", c21 AS "x_inner_limit", c22 AS "x_outer_limit", c23 AS "x_overide_vang_pos_block" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c16,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c21,

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_pull/ease", c3 AS "s_drive_a/x_running", c4 AS "s_drive_b/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive_a/x_brake", c9 AS "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", c10 AS "s_drive_a/x_ready", c11 AS "s_drive_a/x_run", c12 AS "s_drive_b/x_brake", c13 AS "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", c14 AS "s_drive_b/x_ready", c15 AS "s_drive_b/x_run", c16 AS "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_supply_a/x_power_on", c18 AS "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", c19 AS "s_supply_b/x_power_on", c20 AS "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", c21 AS "s_supply_c/x_power_on", c22 AS "x_function_enabled", c23 AS "x_group_enabled", c24 AS "x_running_ccw", c25 AS "x_running_cw" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, c24, c25, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LAG(c24) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p24, LAG(c25) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p25, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_pull") AND bool_or("x_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("x_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("x_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_running") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,

    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_ready") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_run") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_brake") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_can_alive") AS c13,

    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_run") AS c15,

    bool_or("s_supply_b/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("s_supply_b/x_power_on") AS c19,
    bool_or("s_supply_c/x_can_alive") AS c20,

    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c23,
    bool_or("x_running_ccw") AS c24,
    bool_or("x_running_cw") AS c25

  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_pull", "x_ease", "s_drive_a/x_running", "s_drive_b/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive_a/x_brake", "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", "s_drive_a/x_ready", "s_drive_a/x_run", "s_drive_b/x_brake", "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", "s_drive_b/x_ready", "s_drive_b/x_run", "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", "s_supply_a/x_power_on", "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", "s_supply_b/x_power_on", "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", "s_supply_c/x_power_on", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_running_ccw", "x_running_cw" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_pull", "x_ease", "s_drive_a/x_running", "s_drive_b/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive_a/x_brake", "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", "s_drive_a/x_ready", "s_drive_a/x_run", "s_drive_b/x_brake", "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", "s_drive_b/x_ready", "s_drive_b/x_run", "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", "s_supply_a/x_power_on", "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", "s_supply_b/x_power_on", "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", "s_supply_c/x_power_on", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_running_ccw", "x_running_cw" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_pull", "x_ease", "s_drive_a/x_running", "s_drive_b/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive_a/x_brake", "s_drive_a/x_can_alive", "s_drive_a/x_ready", "s_drive_a/x_run", "s_drive_b/x_brake", "s_drive_b/x_can_alive", "s_drive_b/x_ready", "s_drive_b/x_run", "s_supply_a/x_can_alive", "s_supply_a/x_power_on", "s_supply_b/x_can_alive", "s_supply_b/x_power_on", "s_supply_c/x_can_alive", "s_supply_c/x_power_on", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_running_ccw", "x_running_cw" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

) b

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", c2 AS "s_drive_a/x_fault", c3 AS "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive_b/x_fault", c5 AS "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", c6 AS "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", c7 AS "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", c8 AS "x_drive_not_running_alarm", c9 AS "x_speed_deviation_alarm", c10 AS "s_drive_a/w_can_state", c11 AS "s_drive_b/w_can_state", c12 AS "s_supply_a/w_can_state", c13 AS "s_supply_b/w_can_state", c14 AS "s_supply_c/w_can_state", c15 AS "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", c16 AS "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", c17 AS "w_active_fault" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_can_missing") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive_a/x_fault") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive_b/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_supply_a/x_can_missing") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_supply_b/x_can_missing") AS c6,
    bool_or("s_supply_c/x_can_missing") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_drive_not_running_alarm") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_speed_deviation_alarm") AS c9,
    CASE max("s_drive_a/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive_a/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c10,
    CASE max("s_drive_b/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive_b/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c11,
    CASE max("s_supply_a/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_supply_a/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c12,
    CASE max("s_supply_b/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_supply_b/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c13,
    CASE max("s_supply_c/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_supply_c/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c14,
    CAST(max("s_drive_a/w_active_fault") AS VARCHAR) AS c15,
    CAST(max("s_drive_b/w_active_fault") AS VARCHAR) AS c16,
    CAST(max("w_active_fault") AS VARCHAR) AS c17
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p

  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive_a/x_can_missing", "s_drive_a/x_fault", "s_drive_b/x_can_missing", "s_drive_b/x_fault", "s_supply_a/x_can_missing", "s_supply_b/x_can_missing", "s_supply_c/x_can_missing", "x_drive_not_running_alarm", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive_a/w_can_state", "s_drive_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_a/w_can_state", "s_supply_b/w_can_state", "s_supply_c/w_can_state", "s_drive_a/w_active_fault", "s_drive_b/w_active_fault", "w_active_fault" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

spec.title: Drive speed
spec.description: Solid: actual, dashed: demand. Average per interval. Speed in % or rpm as the drive reports it.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("s_drive_a/i_actual_speed") AS "s_drive_a/i_actual_speed",
  avg("s_drive_a/i_speed_demand") AS "s_drive_a/i_speed_demand",

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", c9 AS "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", c10 AS "x_function_enabled", c11 AS "x_group_enabled", c12 AS "x_sensr_in", c13 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_position_ps/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_position_sb/x_can_alive") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c13
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0102_code_sail_tack WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0102_code_sail_tack WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "st_position_ps/x_can_alive", "st_position_sb/x_can_alive", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0102_code_sail_tack WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('r_ease_torque_setting', 'r_pull_torque_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."r_ease_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."r_pull_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."r_ease_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."r_pull_torque_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "r_ease_torque_setting", "r_pull_torque_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "r_ease_torque_setting", "r_pull_torque_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("r_ease_torque_setting") AS n0, max("r_ease_torque_setting") AS x0, min("r_pull_torque_setting") AS n1, max("r_pull_torque_setting") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fe505_mizzen_sheet_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c19 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c20 AS "x_function_enabled", c21 AS "x_group_enabled", c22 AS "x_inner_limit", c23 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,

    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,

    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c19,

    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe402_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe402_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe402_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_pull/ease", c3 AS "ox_pull/ease", c4 AS "ix_mnl_ctrl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_oo_c", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_in", c14 AS "ix_snsr_line", c15 AS "ix_snsr_out", c16 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c18 AS "st_load/x_can_alive", c19 AS "x_activate_line_length_setting", c20 AS "x_function_enabled", c21 AS "x_group_enabled", c22 AS "x_inner_limit", c23 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c22, c23, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LAG(c21) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p21, LAG(c22) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p22, LAG(c23) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p23, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_mnl_ctrl") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_oo_c") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c13,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_line") AS c14,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("st_load/x_can_alive") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_activate_line_length_setting") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c20,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c21,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c22,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c23
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe502_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe502_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_mnl_ctrl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_oo_c", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_line", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "st_load/x_can_alive", "x_activate_line_length_setting", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe502_mizzen_runner_captive_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR (c21 IS DISTINCT FROM p21) OR (c22 IS DISTINCT FROM p22) OR (c23 IS DISTINCT FROM p23) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('io_spd_stp_1', 'io_spd_stp_1_bw', 'io_spd_stp_2', 'io_spd_stp_3', 'st_load/i_load_at_0_v', 'st_load/i_load_change_per_v', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_1_bw" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_0_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_per_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_1_bw" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_0_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_per_v" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "io_spd_stp_1", "io_spd_stp_1_bw", "io_spd_stp_2", "io_spd_stp_3", "st_load/i_load_at_0_v", "st_load/i_load_change_per_v", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe212_primary_deck_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "io_spd_stp_1", "io_spd_stp_1_bw", "io_spd_stp_2", "io_spd_stp_3", "st_load/i_load_at_0_v", "st_load/i_load_change_per_v", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe212_primary_deck_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("io_spd_stp_1") AS n0, max("io_spd_stp_1") AS x0, min("io_spd_stp_1_bw") AS n1, max("io_spd_stp_1_bw") AS x1, min("io_spd_stp_2") AS n2, max("io_spd_stp_2") AS x2, min("io_spd_stp_3") AS n3, max("io_spd_stp_3") AS x3, min("st_load/i_load_at_0_v") AS n4, max("st_load/i_load_at_0_v") AS x4, min("st_load/i_load_change_per_v") AS n5, max("st_load/i_load_change_per_v") AS x5, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n6, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x6 FROM sail_systems__fe212_primary_deck_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_1", c3 AS "ix_btn_2", c4 AS "ix_btn_3", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "s_drive_bw/x_running", c8 AS "x_ext_on_off", c9 AS "x_on_off", c10 AS "x_running", c11 AS "ix_relay_status", c12 AS "ix_snsr_spd", c13 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c14 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c15 AS "s_drive/x_run", c16 AS "s_drive_bw/x_can_alive", c17 AS "s_drive_bw/x_ready", c18 AS "s_drive_bw/x_run", c19 AS "x_function_enabled", c20 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ix_btn_1") AS c2,
    bool_or("ix_btn_2") AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_btn_3") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_spd") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c13,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/x_can_alive") AS c16,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/x_ready") AS c17,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/x_run") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c20
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ix_btn_3", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "s_drive_bw/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "s_drive_bw/x_can_alive", "s_drive_bw/x_ready", "s_drive_bw/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ix_btn_3", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "s_drive_bw/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "s_drive_bw/x_can_alive", "s_drive_bw/x_ready", "s_drive_bw/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ix_btn_3", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "s_drive_bw/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "s_drive_bw/x_can_alive", "s_drive_bw/x_ready", "s_drive_bw/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ix_btn_3", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "s_drive_bw/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "s_drive_bw/x_can_alive", "s_drive_bw/x_ready", "s_drive_bw/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ix_btn_3", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "s_drive_bw/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "s_drive_bw/x_can_alive", "s_drive_bw/x_ready", "s_drive_bw/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c3 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c5 AS "s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage", c6 AS "s_drive_bw/x_can_missing", c7 AS "s_drive_bw/x_fault", c8 AS "st_load/x_failure", c9 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c10 AS "x_power_failure", c11 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c12 AS "s_drive_bw/w_can_state", c13 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode", c14 AS "s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/x_can_missing") AS c6,
    bool_or("s_drive_bw/x_fault") AS c7,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c8,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c10,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c11,
    CASE max("s_drive_bw/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive_bw/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c12,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c13,
    CAST(max("s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c14
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive_bw/x_can_missing", "s_drive_bw/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive_bw/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode", "s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive_bw/x_can_missing", "s_drive_bw/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive_bw/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode", "s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive_bw/x_can_missing", "s_drive_bw/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive_bw/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode", "s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive_bw/x_can_missing", "s_drive_bw/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive_bw/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode", "s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "s_drive_bw/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive_bw/x_can_missing", "s_drive_bw/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive_bw/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode", "s_drive_bw/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe308_primary_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "x_function_enabled", c9 AS "x_group_enabled", c10 AS "x_sensr_in", c11 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c11
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0103_blade_adjuster WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0103_blade_adjuster WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0103_blade_adjuster WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('io_spd_stp_1', 'io_spd_stp_2', 'io_spd_stp_3')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "io_spd_stp_1", "io_spd_stp_2", "io_spd_stp_3" FROM sail_systems__fe105_bow_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "io_spd_stp_1", "io_spd_stp_2", "io_spd_stp_3" FROM sail_systems__fe105_bow_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("io_spd_stp_1") AS n0, max("io_spd_stp_1") AS x0, min("io_spd_stp_2") AS n1, max("io_spd_stp_2") AS x1, min("io_spd_stp_3") AS n2, max("io_spd_stp_3") AS x2 FROM sail_systems__fe105_bow_deck_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c5,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c6,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c7
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe209_main_mast_deck_winch_ps_fwd WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe209_main_mast_deck_winch_ps_fwd WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe209_main_mast_deck_winch_ps_fwd WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_btn_1", c3 AS "ix_btn_2", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_running", c9 AS "ix_relay_status", c10 AS "ix_snsr_spd", c11 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c12 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c13 AS "s_drive/x_run", c14 AS "x_function_enabled", c15 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ix_btn_1") AS c2,
    bool_or("ix_btn_2") AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c8,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_spd") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c14,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c15
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe210_main_mast_deck_winch_ps_aft WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe210_main_mast_deck_winch_ps_aft WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_1", "ix_btn_2", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_spd", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe210_main_mast_deck_winch_ps_aft WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('io_spd_stp_1', 'io_spd_stp_2', 'io_spd_stp_3')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."io_spd_stp_1" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_2" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."io_spd_stp_3" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "io_spd_stp_1", "io_spd_stp_2", "io_spd_stp_3" FROM sail_systems__fe507_mizzen_mast_deck_winch_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s

CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("io_spd_stp_1") AS n0, max("io_spd_stp_1") AS x0, min("io_spd_stp_2") AS n1, max("io_spd_stp_2") AS x1, min("io_spd_stp_3") AS n2, max("io_spd_stp_3") AS x2 FROM sail_systems__fe507_mizzen_mast_deck_winch_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
