    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c11
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0104_staysail_stay_adjuster WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0104_staysail_stay_adjuster WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0104_staysail_stay_adjuster WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR next_time IS NULL

  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE))) AS max

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") AND bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ix_btn_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,

    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c14
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_lmtd_spd_snsr", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_lmtd_spd_snsr", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe506_popup_capstan_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_lmtd_spd_snsr", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe506_popup_capstan_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_lmtd_spd_snsr", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_btn_pull", "ix_btn_ease", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_lmtd_spd_snsr", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe506_popup_capstan_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR next_time IS NULL

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c2 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c3 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c4 AS "x_power_failure", c5 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c6 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c4,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c5,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c6
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe506_popup_capstan_sb WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe506_popup_capstan_sb WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe506_popup_capstan_sb WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR next_time IS NULL

SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c2 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c3 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c4 AS "x_power_failure", c5 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c6 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c3,

spec.title: Configuration

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_high_speed_in_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_high_speed_out_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_highspeed_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_low_speed_in_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_low_speed_out_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_high_speed_in_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_high_speed_out_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_highspeed_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_low_speed_in_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_low_speed_out_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,

  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE))) AS max

CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_high_speed_in_setting") AS n0, max("i_high_speed_in_setting") AS x0, min("i_high_speed_out_setting") AS n1, max("i_high_speed_out_setting") AS x1, min("i_highspeed_delay") AS n2, max("i_highspeed_delay") AS x2, min("i_low_speed_in_setting") AS n3, max("i_low_speed_in_setting") AS x3, min("i_low_speed_out_setting") AS n4, max("i_low_speed_out_setting") AS x4 FROM sail_systems__fe106_anchor_windlass_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_local_furl/unfurl", c3 AS "ox_furl/unfurl", c4 AS "ix_rc_ooc", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "ix_wrk_swtch", c12 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c13 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c14 AS "s_drive/x_run", c15 AS "x_function_enabled", c16 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_local_furl") AND bool_or("ix_local_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_local_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ix_local_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ix_local_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_furl") AND bool_or("ox_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ox_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ox_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ix_rc_ooc") AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_wrk_swtch") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c13,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c14,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c15,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c16
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ix_rc_ooc", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_wrk_swtch", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ix_rc_ooc", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_wrk_swtch", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe108_sail_drum WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ix_rc_ooc", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_wrk_swtch", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe108_sail_drum WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ix_rc_ooc", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_wrk_swtch", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ix_rc_ooc", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_wrk_swtch", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe108_sail_drum WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c2 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c3 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c4 AS "x_power_failure", c5 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c6 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c4,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c5,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c6
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe108_sail_drum WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe108_sail_drum WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe108_sail_drum WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_pull/ease", c3 AS "ix_btn_up/dwn", c4 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c5 AS "s_drive/x_running", c6 AS "x_ext_on_off", c7 AS "x_on_off", c8 AS "x_running", c9 AS "ix_relay_status", c10 AS "ix_snsr_dti", c11 AS "ix_snsr_in", c12 AS "ix_snsr_lti", c13 AS "ix_snsr_out", c14 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c15 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c16 AS "s_drive/x_run", c17 AS "x_function_enabled", c18 AS "x_group_enabled", c19 AS "x_inner_limit", c20 AS "x_outer_limit" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, c16, c17, c18, c19, c20, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LAG(c16) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p16, LAG(c17) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p17, LAG(c18) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p18, LAG(c19) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p19, LAG(c20) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p20, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") AND bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_pull") THEN 'pull' WHEN bool_or("ox_ease") THEN 'ease' WHEN count("ox_pull") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_up") AND bool_or("ix_btn_dwn") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_up") THEN 'up' WHEN bool_or("ix_btn_dwn") THEN 'dwn' WHEN count("ix_btn_up") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c4,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c8,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_dti") AS c10,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_in") AS c11,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_lti") AS c12,
    bool_or("ix_snsr_out") AS c13,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c14,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c15,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c16,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c17,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c18,
    bool_or("x_inner_limit") AS c19,
    bool_or("x_outer_limit") AS c20
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_btn_up", "ix_btn_dwn", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_lti", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_btn_up", "ix_btn_dwn", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_lti", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_btn_up", "ix_btn_dwn", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_lti", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_btn_up", "ix_btn_dwn", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_lti", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_pull", "ox_ease", "ix_btn_up", "ix_btn_dwn", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "ix_snsr_dti", "ix_snsr_in", "ix_snsr_lti", "ix_snsr_out", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_inner_limit", "x_outer_limit" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR (c16 IS DISTINCT FROM p16) OR (c17 IS DISTINCT FROM p17) OR (c18 IS DISTINCT FROM p18) OR (c19 IS DISTINCT FROM p19) OR (c20 IS DISTINCT FROM p20) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c3 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c5 AS "x_pos_out_of_range", c6 AS "x_power_failure", c7 AS "x_snsr_dti_alarm", c8 AS "x_snsr_line_alarm", c9 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c10 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_pos_out_of_range") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_snsr_dti_alarm") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_snsr_line_alarm") AS c8,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c9,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c10
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_pos_out_of_range", "x_power_failure", "x_snsr_dti_alarm", "x_snsr_line_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_pos_out_of_range", "x_power_failure", "x_snsr_dti_alarm", "x_snsr_line_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_pos_out_of_range", "x_power_failure", "x_snsr_dti_alarm", "x_snsr_line_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_pos_out_of_range", "x_power_failure", "x_snsr_dti_alarm", "x_snsr_line_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_pos_out_of_range", "x_power_failure", "x_snsr_dti_alarm", "x_snsr_line_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('st_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 'st_settings/i_lower_slow_position', 'st_settings/i_max_position', 'st_settings/i_min_position', 'st_settings/i_pull_max_speed', 'st_settings/i_slow_speed', 'st_settings/i_upper_slow_position')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."st_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_settings/i_lower_slow_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_settings/i_slow_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_settings/i_upper_slow_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."st_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_settings/i_lower_slow_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_settings/i_slow_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_settings/i_upper_slow_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "st_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "st_settings/i_lower_slow_position", "st_settings/i_max_position", "st_settings/i_min_position", "st_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_settings/i_slow_speed", "st_settings/i_upper_slow_position" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "st_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "st_settings/i_lower_slow_position", "st_settings/i_max_position", "st_settings/i_min_position", "st_settings/i_pull_max_speed", "st_settings/i_slow_speed", "st_settings/i_upper_slow_position" FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("st_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n0, max("st_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x0, min("st_settings/i_lower_slow_position") AS n1, max("st_settings/i_lower_slow_position") AS x1, min("st_settings/i_max_position") AS n2, max("st_settings/i_max_position") AS x2, min("st_settings/i_min_position") AS n3, max("st_settings/i_min_position") AS x3, min("st_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n4, max("st_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x4, min("st_settings/i_slow_speed") AS n5, max("st_settings/i_slow_speed") AS x5, min("st_settings/i_upper_slow_position") AS n6, max("st_settings/i_upper_slow_position") AS x6 FROM sail_systems__fe208_crows_nest_captive WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "x_in/out", c3 AS "x_cyl_a", c4 AS "x_cyl_b", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "x_function_enabled", c9 AS "x_group_enabled", c10 AS "x_sensr_in", c11 AS "x_sensr_out" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_in") AND bool_or("x_out") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("x_in") THEN 'in' WHEN bool_or("x_out") THEN 'out' WHEN count("x_in") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    bool_or("x_cyl_a") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_cyl_b") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c9,
    bool_or("x_sensr_in") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_sensr_out") AS c11
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "x_in", "x_out", "x_cyl_a", "x_cyl_b", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_sensr_in", "x_sensr_out" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_feed_forward_pressure_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n0, max("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x0 FROM sail_systems__f0303_spare WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", c2 AS "x_close_timeout", c3 AS "x_open_timeout", c4 AS "x_sensor_failure" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c1,
    bool_or("x_close_timeout") AS c2,
    bool_or("x_open_timeout") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_sensor_failure") AS c4
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "x_close_timeout", "x_open_timeout", "x_sensor_failure" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "x_close_timeout", "x_open_timeout", "x_sensor_failure" FROM sail_systems__f0403_crew_boarding_platform_ps WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/ox_gnrl_alrm", "x_close_timeout", "x_open_timeout", "x_sensor_failure" FROM sail_systems__f0403_crew_boarding_platform_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

    GROUP BY 1
  ) a

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_feed_forward_pressure_setting', 'st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0403_crew_boarding_platform_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" FROM sail_systems__f0403_crew_boarding_platform_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n0, max("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x0, min("st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n1, max("st_f_0404_lock_cylinder/i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__f0403_crew_boarding_platform_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ox_oilsply_b") AS c2,

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,

  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_feed_forward_pressure_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_cylinder_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_position/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,

  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE))) AS max

FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_feed_forward_pressure_setting", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting", "st_position/i_cylinder_length", "st_position/i_max_position", "st_position/i_min_position" FROM sail_systems__f0206_blade_tweaker_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS n0, max("i_feed_forward_pressure_setting") AS x0, min("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS n1, max("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS x1, min("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS n2, max("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS x2, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n3, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x3, min("st_position/i_cylinder_length") AS n4, max("st_position/i_cylinder_length") AS x4, min("st_position/i_max_position") AS n5, max("st_position/i_max_position") AS x5, min("st_position/i_min_position") AS n6, max("st_position/i_min_position") AS x6 FROM sail_systems__f0206_blade_tweaker_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ix_estop", c1 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c2 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c3 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c5 AS "x_power_failure", c6 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c7 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ix_estop") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c5,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c6,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c7
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ix_estop", "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ix_estop", "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__f0600_tender_crane WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ix_estop", "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__f0600_tender_crane WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ix_estop", "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ix_estop", "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__f0600_tender_crane WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_fcu_enbl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_ext_set_mode_auto", "x_ext_set_mode_off", "x_ext_set_mode_on", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_set_mode_auto", "x_set_mode_off", "x_set_mode_on", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_mode_auto", "x_mode_off", "x_mode_on" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_fcu_enbl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_ext_set_mode_auto", "x_ext_set_mode_off", "x_ext_set_mode_on", "x_on_off", "x_running", "x_set_mode_auto", "x_set_mode_off", "x_set_mode_on", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled", "x_mode_auto", "x_mode_off", "x_mode_on" FROM sail_systems__fpp1_powerpack1 WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s

  ) a

spec.title: Drive speed

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("s_drive/i_actual_speed") AS "s_drive/i_actual_speed",
  avg("s_drive/i_speed_demand") AS "s_drive/i_speed_demand"

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_load_sense_offset', 'i_off_delay_settings')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_load_sense_offset" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_off_delay_settings" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_load_sense_offset" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_off_delay_settings" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_load_sense_offset", "i_off_delay_settings" FROM sail_systems__fpp1_powerpack1 WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_load_sense_offset", "i_off_delay_settings" FROM sail_systems__fpp1_powerpack1 WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_load_sense_offset") AS n0, max("i_load_sense_offset") AS x0, min("i_off_delay_settings") AS n1, max("i_off_delay_settings") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fpp1_powerpack1 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Drive speed

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_load_sense_offset', 'i_off_delay_settings')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_load_sense_offset" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_off_delay_settings" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_load_sense_offset" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_off_delay_settings" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_load_sense_offset", "i_off_delay_settings" FROM sail_systems__fpp2_powerpack2 WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_load_sense_offset", "i_off_delay_settings" FROM sail_systems__fpp2_powerpack2 WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_load_sense_offset") AS n0, max("i_load_sense_offset") AS x0, min("i_off_delay_settings") AS n1, max("i_off_delay_settings") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fpp2_powerpack2 WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_delay_time', 's_frpk/i_max_temperature', 's_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature', 's_lzrtt/i_max_temperature', 's_tch_spc/i_max_temperature')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_delay_time" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_frpk/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_lzrtt/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_tch_spc/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_delay_time" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_frpk/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_lzrtt/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_tch_spc/i_max_temperature" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_delay_time", "s_frpk/i_max_temperature", "s_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature", "s_lzrtt/i_max_temperature", "s_tch_spc/i_max_temperature" FROM sail_systems__cooling_pumps WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_delay_time", "s_frpk/i_max_temperature", "s_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature", "s_lzrtt/i_max_temperature", "s_tch_spc/i_max_temperature" FROM sail_systems__cooling_pumps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_delay_time") AS n0, max("i_delay_time") AS x0, min("s_frpk/i_max_temperature") AS n1, max("s_frpk/i_max_temperature") AS x1, min("s_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature") AS n2, max("s_hlyrdpt/i_max_temperature") AS x2, min("s_lzrtt/i_max_temperature") AS n3, max("s_lzrtt/i_max_temperature") AS x3, min("s_tch_spc/i_max_temperature") AS n4, max("s_tch_spc/i_max_temperature") AS x4 FROM sail_systems__cooling_pumps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  avg("st_position/i_position_mm") AS "st_position/i_position_mm",
  min("st_position/i_position_mm") AS "st_position/i_position_mm min",
  max("st_position/i_position_mm") AS "st_position/i_position_mm max",
  max("st_position/i_max_position") AS "st_position/i_max_position",

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_furl_speed_setting', 'i_unfurl_speed_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_furl_speed_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_unfurl_speed_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_furl_speed_setting" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_unfurl_speed_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_furl_speed_setting", "i_unfurl_speed_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe101_code_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_furl_speed_setting", "i_unfurl_speed_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe101_code_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_furl_speed_setting") AS n0, max("i_furl_speed_setting") AS x0, min("i_unfurl_speed_setting") AS n1, max("i_unfurl_speed_setting") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fe101_code_furler WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_local_furl/unfurl", c3 AS "ix_rc_furl/unfurl", c4 AS "ox_furl/unfurl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c12 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c13 AS "x_function_enabled", c14 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_local_furl") AND bool_or("ix_local_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_local_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ix_local_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ix_local_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_rc_furl") AND bool_or("ix_rc_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_rc_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ix_rc_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ix_rc_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_furl") AND bool_or("ox_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ox_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ox_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c12,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c14
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe102_blade_furler WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe102_blade_furler WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe102_blade_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_furl_speed_setting", "i_unfurl_speed_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe102_blade_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_furl_speed_setting", "i_unfurl_speed_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe102_blade_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_furl_speed_setting") AS n0, max("i_furl_speed_setting") AS x0, min("i_unfurl_speed_setting") AS n1, max("i_unfurl_speed_setting") AS x1 FROM sail_systems__fe102_blade_furler WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

spec.title: Commands and status
spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ix_local_furl/unfurl", c3 AS "ix_rc_furl/unfurl", c4 AS "ox_furl/unfurl", c5 AS "ox_pwr_enable", c6 AS "s_drive/x_running", c7 AS "x_ext_on_off", c8 AS "x_on_off", c9 AS "x_running", c10 AS "ix_relay_status", c11 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c12 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c13 AS "s_drive/x_run", c14 AS "x_function_enabled", c15 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, c13, c14, c15, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LAG(c13) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p13, LAG(c14) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p14, LAG(c15) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p15, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_local_furl") AND bool_or("ix_local_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_local_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ix_local_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ix_local_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c2,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ix_rc_furl") AND bool_or("ix_rc_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ix_rc_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ix_rc_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ix_rc_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c3,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("ox_furl") AND bool_or("ox_unfurl") THEN 'both' WHEN bool_or("ox_furl") THEN 'furl' WHEN bool_or("ox_unfurl") THEN 'unfurl' WHEN count("ox_furl") > 0 THEN 'idle' END AS c4,
    bool_or("ox_pwr_enable") AS c5,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c7,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c8,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c9,
    bool_or("ix_relay_status") AS c10,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c11,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c12,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c13,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c14,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c15
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe103_staysail_furler WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe103_staysail_furler WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ix_local_furl", "ix_local_unfurl", "ix_rc_furl", "ix_rc_unfurl", "ox_furl", "ox_unfurl", "ox_pwr_enable", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "ix_relay_status", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe103_staysail_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR (c13 IS DISTINCT FROM p13) OR (c14 IS DISTINCT FROM p14) OR (c15 IS DISTINCT FROM p15) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c2 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c3 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c4 AS "x_power_failure", c5 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c6 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c3,
    bool_or("x_power_failure") AS c4,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c5,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c6
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe103_staysail_furler WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe103_staysail_furler WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "x_power_failure", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe103_staysail_furler WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_set_actual_line_length', 's_settings/i_ease_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_ease_max_speed', 's_settings/i_line_tension_delay', 's_settings/i_max_position', 's_settings/i_min_position', 's_settings/i_pull_btn_speed', 's_settings/i_pull_max_speed')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_set_actual_line_length" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_ease_max_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_line_tension_delay" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_max_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_min_position" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n7 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x5 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x6 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x7 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe201_blade_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_set_actual_line_length", "s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_ease_max_speed", "s_settings/i_line_tension_delay", "s_settings/i_max_position", "s_settings/i_min_position", "s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed", "s_settings/i_pull_max_speed" FROM sail_systems__fe201_blade_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_set_actual_line_length") AS n0, max("i_set_actual_line_length") AS x0, min("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS n1, max("s_settings/i_ease_btn_speed") AS x1, min("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS n2, max("s_settings/i_ease_max_speed") AS x2, min("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS n3, max("s_settings/i_line_tension_delay") AS x3, min("s_settings/i_max_position") AS n4, max("s_settings/i_max_position") AS x4, min("s_settings/i_min_position") AS n5, max("s_settings/i_min_position") AS x5, min("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS n6, max("s_settings/i_pull_btn_speed") AS x6, min("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS n7, max("s_settings/i_pull_max_speed") AS x7 FROM sail_systems__fe201_blade_sheet_captive_winch_ps WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r

GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Blue: command or PLC output (ox_) on, green: status true. Opposite commands such as pull/ease share a lane. x_on_off: HMI toggle, x_ext_on_off: AMCS toggle.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "i_state", c1 AS "mode", c2 AS "ox_low_torque", c3 AS "ox_pull", c4 AS "s_drive/x_running", c5 AS "x_ext_on_off", c6 AS "x_on_off", c7 AS "x_running", c8 AS "s_drive/x_can_alive", c9 AS "s_drive/x_ready", c10 AS "s_drive/x_run", c11 AS "x_function_enabled", c12 AS "x_group_enabled" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10, c11, c12, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LAG(c10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p10, LAG(c11) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p11, LAG(c12) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p12, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    CASE max("i_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'group off' WHEN 1 THEN 'enabled, idle' WHEN 2 THEN 'function off' WHEN 3 THEN 'active' ELSE CAST(max("i_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c0,
    CASE WHEN bool_or("x_maintenance") THEN 'maintenance' WHEN bool_or("x_rc_control") THEN 'remote' WHEN bool_or("x_local_control") THEN 'local' ELSE 'none' END AS c1,
    bool_or("ox_low_torque") AS c2,
    bool_or("ox_pull") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_running") AS c4,
    bool_or("x_ext_on_off") AS c5,
    bool_or("x_on_off") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_running") AS c7,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_alive") AS c8,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_ready") AS c9,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_run") AS c10,
    bool_or("x_function_enabled") AS c11,
    bool_or("x_group_enabled") AS c12
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "i_state", "x_maintenance", "x_rc_control", "x_local_control", "ox_low_torque", "ox_pull", "s_drive/x_running", "x_ext_on_off", "x_on_off", "x_running", "s_drive/x_can_alive", "s_drive/x_ready", "s_drive/x_run", "x_function_enabled", "x_group_enabled" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR (c10 IS DISTINCT FROM p10) OR (c11 IS DISTINCT FROM p11) OR (c12 IS DISTINCT FROM p12) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Red: alarm active. CAN state: off, ok or fault. Alarm codes as numbers, 0 = none.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, c0 AS "ox_gnrl_alrm", c1 AS "ox_load_alarm", c2 AS "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", c3 AS "s_drive/x_can_missing", c4 AS "s_drive/x_fault", c5 AS "st_load/x_failure", c6 AS "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", c7 AS "x_speed_deviation_alarm", c8 AS "s_drive/w_can_state", c9 AS "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (
  SELECT time, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, LAG(c0) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p0, LAG(c1) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p1, LAG(c2) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p2, LAG(c3) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p3, LAG(c4) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p4, LAG(c5) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p5, LAG(c6) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p6, LAG(c7) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p7, LAG(c8) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p8, LAG(c9) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS p9, LEAD(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM (
    SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
    bool_or("ox_gnrl_alrm") AS c0,
    bool_or("ox_load_alarm") AS c1,
    bool_or("s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage") AS c2,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_can_missing") AS c3,
    bool_or("s_drive/x_fault") AS c4,
    bool_or("st_load/x_failure") AS c5,
    bool_or("st_load/x_max_limit_reached") AS c6,
    bool_or("x_speed_deviation_alarm") AS c7,
    CASE max("s_drive/w_can_state") WHEN 0 THEN 'CAN off' WHEN 1 THEN 'CAN ok' WHEN 2 THEN 'CAN fault' ELSE CAST(max("s_drive/w_can_state") AS VARCHAR) END AS c8,
    CAST(max("s_drive/ow_alarmcode") AS VARCHAR) AS c9
    FROM (SELECT $__fromTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp < $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) p
  UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT $__toTime AS timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM (SELECT timestamp, "ox_gnrl_alrm", "ox_load_alarm", "s_drive/no_dc_link_voltage", "s_drive/x_can_missing", "s_drive/x_fault", "st_load/x_failure", "st_load/x_max_limit_reached", "x_speed_deviation_alarm", "s_drive/w_can_state", "s_drive/ow_alarmcode" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e) s
    GROUP BY 1
  ) a
) b
WHERE (c0 IS DISTINCT FROM p0) OR (c1 IS DISTINCT FROM p1) OR (c2 IS DISTINCT FROM p2) OR (c3 IS DISTINCT FROM p3) OR (c4 IS DISTINCT FROM p4) OR (c5 IS DISTINCT FROM p5) OR (c6 IS DISTINCT FROM p6) OR (c7 IS DISTINCT FROM p7) OR (c8 IS DISTINCT FROM p8) OR (c9 IS DISTINCT FROM p9) OR next_time IS NULL
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Configuration
spec.description: Each PLC setting at the start and end of the range, and its min and max in it; min and max differ when it changed. Raw PLC units (loads in daN, positions in mm).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT unnest(make_array('i_max_speed_stp', 'i_max_torque_stp', 'st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a', 'st_load/i_load_change_perm_a', 'st_load/i_max_load_setting')) AS setting,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(s."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(s."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_start,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(e."i_max_speed_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."i_max_torque_stp" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_load_change_perm_a" AS DOUBLE), CAST(e."st_load/i_max_load_setting" AS DOUBLE))) AS at_end,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.n0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.n4 AS DOUBLE))) AS min,
  unnest(make_array(CAST(r.x0 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x1 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x2 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x3 AS DOUBLE), CAST(r.x4 AS DOUBLE))) AS max
FROM (SELECT "i_max_speed_stp", "i_max_torque_stp", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__fromTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) s
FULL JOIN (SELECT "i_max_speed_stp", "i_max_torque_stp", "st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a", "st_load/i_load_change_perm_a", "st_load/i_max_load_setting" FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE timestamp <= $__toTime ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min("i_max_speed_stp") AS n0, max("i_max_speed_stp") AS x0, min("i_max_torque_stp") AS n1, max("i_max_torque_stp") AS x1, min("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS n2, max("st_load/i_load_at_4_rm_a") AS x2, min("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS n3, max("st_load/i_load_change_perm_a") AS x3, min("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS n4, max("st_load/i_max_load_setting") AS x4 FROM sail_systems__fe202_blade_sheet_ps_feeder WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) r
